description: Land Title Settlement Dept. - Haragama, Kandy D/S Division, Kandy District (25/5514114)
categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with land title registration matters, including declarations of title determination for specific land parcels, ownership details, property boundaries, and land registration under the Registration of Title Act. It contains detailed schedules with land parcel numbers, owner information, property extents, and encumbrances, which clearly falls under the Land Gazettes category (Type 4) for land and property-related matters.
